attempts.summary: Created a local CA "OS Comparison Root CA" (RSA 4096, self-signed, 10-year validity) on node1 (RHEL 10), installed its certificate into the system trust anchors via update-ca-trust, and verified trust via `trust list` and `openssl verify`. Then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured pre-restart boot_id and trust state, issued `shutdown -r now` in background so the ack returned before disconnection, polled until the node was reachable again, confirmed the boot_id changed, and re-verified the CA is still present and trusted (anchor/authority) with openssl verify succeeding post-restart.
